name: pdlc
description: Bootstrap a new or existing project for the praxis development lifecycle — plant the always-on PDLC grounding (CLAUDE.md), wire the .handoff/ transport, opt into the peer utilities (Backlog.md, Spec Kit) — and orchestrate multi-task board sweeps through that lifecycle: pdlc:sweep authors a dependency-laned, operator-signed-off runbook, then runs every task through spec, PR, merge, and re-ground.
